findings.title: As flooded town works to rebuild, some wonder what’s next
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Edward Vest owns the only grocery store, IGA, in McCaysville. He’s uncertain about if he will rebuild.
findings.summary: New local reporting at 3:51 p.m. PST says McCaysville's only grocery store, IGA, was damaged by flooding and is not operating; owner Edward Vest cannot say when it will reopen or whether he will rebuild, estimating $2 million–$3 million to restore it. Roughly 22–24 employees and community grocery access are affected. The flood occurred days earlier, but this specific sole-grocery loss was newly verified and surfaced within the observation window. No reopening date confirmed.
affected_groups: McCaysville residents dependent on the only local grocery store
